learning_outcomes.text: Students identify engineering problems with analytical thinking ability.
Students learn to solve a given problem by developing data collection and formulation skills.
Students gain knowledge about basic Mathematics, Science, and Electrical Engineering and can apply it.
Students acquire the ability to design, conduct, analyze, and interpret the results of a desired engineering experiment.
Students acquire the ability to identify, define, and solve engineering problems they encounter.

syllabus_topics: Linear equation solutions (Cremer Method, Gauss Jourdan Method)
Linear equation solutions (Gauss Elimination Method, Crouth Components Method)
Linear Equation Solutions (Jacobi iteration Method, Gauss Seidel Method)
Finding non-linear equation roots (bisection, false position, secant methods)
Finding non-linear equation roots (Newton Raphson, fixed-point iteration methods)
Solution of non-linear equation systems (Newton Raphson and fixed-point iteration methods)
Interpolation (forward difference and divided difference interpolation, Gregory Newton Interpolation Methods)
